with orders as (
    select 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        order_purchase_timestamp :: timestamp as order_purchase_timestamp,
        order_approved_at :: timestamp as order_approved_at,
        order_delivered_carrier_date :: timestamp as order_delivered_carrier_date,
        order_delivered_customer_date :: timestamp as order_delivered_customer_date,
        order_estimated_delivery_date :: timestamp as order_estimated_delivery_date
    from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_orders"
)

select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(order_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(customer_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(order_purchase_timestamp as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as order_pk,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    case 
        when order_status = 'delivered' and order_delivered_customer_date is null then 'unavailable'
        else order_status
    end as order_status, 
    order_purchase_timestamp,
    order_approved_at,
    order_delivered_carrier_date,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,
    
    -- Delivery Duration in Days
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) as days_to_deliver,
    
    -- Estimate Difference (Negative means delivered earlier than estimated)
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_estimated_delivery_date)) as delivery_delay_days,
    
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_estimated_delivery_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) as estimated_delivery_days,
    
    -- Operational Flag
    case 
        when order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date and order_status = 'delivered'then true 
        when order_delivered_customer_date < order_estimated_delivery_date and order_status = 'delivered'then false
        else null 
    end as is_delivery_delayed

from orders

with orders as (
    select 
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(o.order_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(o.customer_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as order_pk,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_pk,
        r.review_pk,
        p.payment_det_pk,
        o.order_status,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_approved_at,
        o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        o.days_to_deliver,
        o.delivery_delay_days,
        o.estimated_delivery_days,
        o.is_delivery_delayed
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_orders" o
    left join "ecommerce_db"."marts"."customer_dim" c using(customer_id)
    left join "ecommerce_db"."marts"."reviews_dim" r using(order_id)
    left join "ecommerce_db"."marts"."payment_dim" p using(order_id)
 ), 
  order_review_agg as (
    select 
        order_id,
        avg(review_score) as avg_review_score,
        count(review_id) as total_reviews
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_order_reviews"
    group by 1
  ),
  order_payment_det as (
    select 
        order_id,
        sum(payment_value) as total_payment_value
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_order_payments"
    group by 1
  ),
  final as(

select 
    o.*,
    r.avg_review_score,
    r.total_reviews,
    p.total_payment_value
from orders o 
left join order_review_agg r using (order_id)
left join order_payment_det p using (order_id) 
  )



select s.*
from final s
left join "ecommerce_db"."marts"."order_fct" t
    on s.order_id = t.order_id
where
    t.order_id is null
    or s.order_pk 
        is distinct from t.order_pk
    or s.order_status
        is distinct from t.order_status

    or s.order_approved_at
        is distinct from t.order_approved_at

    or s.order_delivered_carrier_date
        is distinct from t.order_delivered_carrier_date

    or s.order_delivered_customer_date
        is distinct from t.order_delivered_customer_date

    or s.order_estimated_delivery_date
        is distinct from t.order_estimated_delivery_date
